morpy.repository module¶

Module¶

SQLite-backed persistence and live-process registry for run metadata.

This module provides:

  • RunRepository protocol: persistence API consumed by observers/status.

  • SQLiteRunRepository: concrete SQLAlchemy + SQLite implementation.

  • LiveProcessRegistry: in-memory registry for currently running subprocesses.

  • RepositoryObserver: adapter that writes run events into the repository.

Persistence and live process tracking are intentionally separated: the database stores durable history, while the live registry stores active Popen handles that cannot be persisted meaningfully.

class morpy.repository.LiveProcessRegistry[source]

Bases: object

In-memory registry of currently running subprocesses by model_id.

This registry is the real-time companion to SQLite history:

  • register stores a launched process with its RunHandle.

  • get returns None if unknown or if the process already exited.

  • list_running_model_ids returns only currently alive processes.

  • terminate supports graceful shutdown with optional force-kill fallback.

Lifecycle behavior:

  • Stale entries are pruned lazily during lookups.

  • Registry content is process-local and not durable.

class morpy.repository.RepositoryObserver(repo)[source]

Bases: object

Observer adapter that persists run lifecycle events.

This class implements the RunObserver callback shape and delegates each event to a RunRepository implementation:

on_state_transition -> record_state_transition on_process_started -> record_run_started on_process_finished -> record_run_finished

Use this observer when running models so status queries can reconstruct current and historical state from repository data.

class morpy.repository.SQLiteRunRepository(db_path)[source]

Bases: object

SQLite-backed implementation of RunRepository using SQLAlchemy.

Responsibilities:

Create schema on first use. Upsert current model snapshot records. Append state transition events. Record run start and terminal run results. Rehydrate RunResult and StateTransition read models from rows.

Notes

JSON-like fields are serialized to compact JSON text for SQLite storage. Timestamp columns are stored as timezone-aware datetimes. Writes are transaction-scoped using SessionLocal.begin().

db_path (str | Path)

class morpy.repository.Tracker(repo, live_tracker, observer)[source]

Bases: object

Tracker object that holds the SQL repository (SQLiteRunRepository) instance that keeps track of the running models, the live_tracker (LiveProcessRegistry) that tracks additional in-memory information about the models (only available if initiated in same Python session) and the observer object (RunObserver) that registers state changes.
